text:
alex: Draft RN ready for ops review — v2.3.7-rc1. Planning quiet window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC; canaries + deploybot schedule. Short rollback plan included. PTAL.
maria: on it. quick q: which endpoints are we pinning? will we pin both text-gen and embeddings?
alex: Pin text-gen -> v2.3.7-rc1 (int8) only. embeddings stay on v2.3.6 as fallback. reason: cost/perf regression noted on int8 embed candidate.
deploybot: deploybot: canary job scheduled for 1768013400 (02:10 UTC). Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm. Commands: `/deploy canary v2.3.7-rc1 --route=5%`
sam: added RN bullets: CVE-2026-01 fix, perf improvements, and a known issue about subtle tokenization mismatch. someone add SRE rollback thresholds?
jordana: SRE input: rollback if error rate > 2.5% over 5m OR p99 latency > 800ms sustained for 10m. Also auto-fallback to embeddings v2.3.6 on consecutive errors > 100 in 5m.
liz: ops note: we can do the window, but oncall @mike will be offline 02:30-02:45 — can we stagger canary so critical checks finish before 02:30?
alex: ok tweak: shift canary start to 02:05, promote to 30% at 02:20, full rollout at 02:40 if green. update RN timeline to match.
deploybot: deploybot: schedule updated per request — canary start 02:05, promote 30% at 02:20, full at 02:40. Pin command after rollout: `/deploy pin v2.3.7-rc1 --env=prod`.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll update the doc and draft the internal announce copy. Draft announce: "Rolling out v2.3.7 with security fix and perf wins. Canary 02:05 UTC. Expect short infra noise; please report anomalies to #incidents or tag #release-rollback."
sam: please add an explicit instruction: if you see increase in error-rate, add tag `#release-rollback` to the incident and mention oncall.
alex: final asks: who will run the smoke checklist at 02:00 (pre-canary)? need someone to post results quickly. @liz?
liz: roger, I'll run smoke at 02:00 and post quick pass/fail in this thread. If smoke fails, abort with `/deploy abort canary`.
deploybot: deploybot: reminder — `/deploy abort` must be run within 15m of canary start to prevent automated promotion. Logs/links: doc: https://docs.internal.company/rn/v2.3.7-rc1, deploy dashboard: https://deploy.company/status/v2.3.7-rc1
